title: Claude Code relaunches Projects to manage multiple AI agents in the cloud
slides: Claude Code's Projects: your agents, one place?
It now runs multiple AI agents in the cloud
But agents can silently conflict with each other
You still must define each agent's boundaries
Set up one shared workspace this week
thread_text:
1. Agents now run in the cloud

Claude Code's new Projects feature lets multiple AI agents work together on one codebase. No more local setup.

2. Silent conflicts between agents

Two agents can edit the same file at the same time. The result? Broken code and hours of debugging.

3. You set the boundaries

Each agent needs clear limits: which files they own, what tasks they can do. Without rules, chaos.

4. One shared workspace

All agents see the same project state. Changes are synced, but only if you define who does what.

5. Try it this week

Take one small project and add two agents with different roles. See if they conflict. That's your test.

instagram.caption:
Multiple AI agents can now share one codebase in the cloud, no local setup needed. 🤖

Claude Code relaunched Projects so several agents work together on the same project.

Problem is, two agents can edit the same file at once and silently break your code. 😬

Changes sync across the shared workspace, but only if you define who owns what.

So for anyone shipping code or content with AI help, the setup work now matters as much as the prompts. 🛠️

If you added two agents with different roles this week, would you even notice them colliding?
